title: -DIr: assumption and authority
summary: Make a confident assumption with `-DIr` (*Yorulmuşlardır*), recognize `-DIr` and `-mIştIr` as the voice of encyclopedias and academic prose, choose the right adverb of certainty, and place every form you know on a scale from certain to guessed.
canDo: Make a confident assumption about the present or the past
Read and write encyclopedic sentences in -DIr and -mIştIr
Say how sure you are with the right adverb
Tell what a writer knows, infers, estimates or only reports as a claim
